title: Our favourite sweet foods 🍦🍭🍫  Practise your listening with Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hi Georgie. How are you?
sentences.ko: 안녕, 조지. 잘 지내?

sentences.en: I'm pretty good thank you, Phil.
sentences.ko: 꽤 잘 지내, 고마워 필.

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.ko: 너는 어떻게 지내?

sentences.en: I'm really good.
sentences.ko: 정말 잘 지내.

sentences.en: I think you're going to be even better when you find out what we're talking about today.
sentences.ko: 오늘 무슨 얘기를 하는지 알면 너는 훨씬 더 좋아질 것 같아.

sentences.en: Tell me.
sentences.ko: 말해 줘.

sentences.en: Well, I know we often talk about food, but today we're talking about desserts.
sentences.ko: 음, 우리가 음식 얘기를 자주 하는 건 알지만, 오늘은 디저트에 대해 이야기할 거야.

sentences.en: You were right.
sentences.ko: 네 말이 맞았어.

sentences.en: I love desserts or puddings – sometimes we call them puddings in the UK.
sentences.ko: 나 디저트, 아니면 푸딩 정말 좋아해. 영국에서는 가끔 푸딩이라고도 불러.

sentences.en: I have a big sweet tooth so, yeah, I will love this.
sentences.ko: 나 단 걸 엄청 좋아해서, 응, 이거 정말 좋을 거야.

sentences.en: I will love talking about this topic.
sentences.ko: 이 주제로 얘기하는 거 정말 좋을 거야.

sentences.en: Fantastic. Let's get started.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 시작하자.

sentences.en: Well, first, before we start talking about my favourite topic, we have to remind our listeners that they can find a free worksheet and transcript to help them learn at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 음, 내가 제일 좋아하는 주제를 얘기하기 전에, 공부에 도움이 되는 무료 워크시트와 대본을 bbclearningenglish.com에서 찾을 수 있다는 걸 청취자분들께 알려드려야 해요.

sentences.en: So, Georgie, I think this is a silly question and I think I know the answer already, but do you like desserts?
sentences.ko: 그럼 조지, 바보 같은 질문이고 답도 이미 알 것 같지만, 디저트 좋아해?

sentences.en: Ah... do I like desserts?
sentences.ko: 아... 내가 디저트를 좋아하냐고?

sentences.en: I love desserts!
sentences.ko: 디저트 엄청 좋아해!

sentences.en: I have a really big sweet tooth, which means that I really like sweet things, sugary things – I put sugar in my coffee sometimes.
sentences.ko: 나는 단 걸 정말 좋아해(a sweet tooth). 달달한 거, 설탕 들어간 거 정말 좋아한다는 뜻이야. 가끔 커피에 설탕도 넣어.

sentences.en: But I... if I'm in a restaurant, I will always order a dessert.
sentences.ko: 그리고 레스토랑에 가면 항상 디저트를 시켜.

sentences.en: I would prefer to have a dessert or pudding than a starter, actually.
sentences.ko: 사실 애피타이저보다 디저트나 푸딩을 먹는 게 더 좋아.

sentences.en: Yeah. What about you? Do you like them?
sentences.ko: 응. 너는 어때? 디저트 좋아해?

sentences.en: Yeah, I do. I think...
sentences.ko: 응, 좋아해. 내 생각엔...

sentences.en: I think in a restaurant I'd probably order a starter rather than a dessert.
sentences.ko: 레스토랑에서는 아마 디저트보다는 애피타이저를 시킬 것 같아.

sentences.en: But yeah, it's nice when you get a good one.
sentences.ko: 그래도 응, 맛있는 걸 먹으면 좋지.

sentences.en: Ah, it's so good.
sentences.ko: 아, 정말 맛있지.

sentences.en: I quite like homemade desserts – so, I don't know... homemade apple crumble.
sentences.ko: 나는 집에서 만든 디저트를 꽤 좋아해. 음... 홈메이드 애플 크럼블 같은 거.

sentences.en: Ooh, that's really good.
sentences.ko: 오, 그거 정말 맛있지.

sentences.en: So, that's when we cook the apples a little bit so they're quite soft, and then we put a biscuit topping at the top.
sentences.ko: 사과를 살짝 익혀서 꽤 부드럽게 만들고, 그 위에 비스킷 토핑을 올리는 거야.

sentences.en: And it's really, really delicious.
sentences.ko: 정말, 정말 맛있어.

sentences.en: And it's a hot... a hot dessert.
sentences.ko: 그리고 따뜻한... 따뜻한 디저트야.

sentences.en: Yeah. And a lot of fruit puddings that I quite like – they're sweet but they're also a bit sharp as well.
sentences.ko: 응. 그리고 내가 꽤 좋아하는 과일 푸딩들은 달면서도 좀 새콤해(sharp).

sentences.en: A bit sweet, a bit sour.
sentences.ko: 조금 달고, 조금 시고.

sentences.en: That's a really nice combination. I love that.
sentences.ko: 그거 정말 좋은 조합이지. 나 그거 좋아.

sentences.en: Well, I do love fruit puddings but I am a chocolate person, so if I have a menu in a restaurant, I will always look for the chocolate dessert – maybe a chocolate brownie, chocolate cake, ice cream as well.
sentences.ko: 나도 과일 푸딩을 좋아하긴 하지만 나는 초콜릿파야. 그래서 레스토랑에서 메뉴를 보면 항상 초콜릿 디저트를 찾아. 초콜릿 브라우니나 초콜릿 케이크, 아이스크림도.

sentences.en: That's a really good dessert.
sentences.ko: 그거 정말 좋은 디저트지.

sentences.en: And sometimes if you're feeling very full after the meal, ice cream is a good option because it doesn't feel too filling, does it?
sentences.ko: 그리고 가끔 식사 후에 배가 너무 부를 때는 아이스크림이 좋은 선택이야. 그렇게 배부르지 않잖아, 그렇지?

sentences.en: Do you like ice cream?
sentences.ko: 아이스크림 좋아해?

sentences.en: Yes, I really love ice cream.
sentences.ko: 응, 아이스크림 정말 좋아해.

sentences.en: I like most flavours of ice cream, I think.
sentences.ko: 아이스크림은 웬만한 맛은 다 좋은 것 같아.

sentences.en: I like the creamy ones and then some of the fruity ones as well, like mango ice cream or something.
sentences.ko: 크림 같은 것도 좋고, 망고 아이스크림 같은 과일 맛도 좋아.

sentences.en: On a hot day you can't beat it.
sentences.ko: 더운 날엔 그만한 게 없지.

sentences.en: Do you often eat dessert?
sentences.ko: 디저트 자주 먹어?

sentences.en: No, I don't think I do.
sentences.ko: 아니, 그렇진 않은 것 같아.

sentences.en: Not that often. I keep it as a treat for, like, a special occasion or something to make a meal feel really special – dessert with it. But yeah, I wouldn't...
sentences.ko: 그렇게 자주는 아니야. 특별한 날이나 식사를 정말 특별하게 만들고 싶을 때 먹는 간식으로 남겨둬. 그래도 응, 나는...

sentences.en: I wouldn't have it every week, I don't think.
sentences.ko: 매주 먹지는 않을 것 같아.

sentences.en: No, because it's not very healthy to eat too much sugar, is it?
sentences.ko: 그렇지, 설탕을 너무 많이 먹는 건 별로 건강하지 않으니까, 그렇지?

sentences.en: You're very good.
sentences.ko: 너 정말 대단하다.

sentences.en: I do eat pudding and dessert quite a lot.
sentences.ko: 나는 푸딩이랑 디저트를 꽤 많이 먹어.

sentences.en: I... Yeah, I just get really strong sugar cravings after meals.
sentences.ko: 나는... 응, 식사 후에 단 게 엄청 당겨.

sentences.en: What's the best dessert you've ever had?
sentences.ko: 지금까지 먹어본 디저트 중에 최고는 뭐야?

sentences.en: OK. Well, I said that my favourite puddings are chocolatey, but actually I think the best dessert I've ever tried, because it was the first time, was when I was in Jordan and I tried something called knafeh, and this is like a...
sentences.ko: 좋아. 내가 제일 좋아하는 푸딩은 초콜릿 들어간 거라고 했는데, 사실 처음 먹어봐서 그런지 지금까지 먹어본 최고의 디저트는 요르단에 갔을 때 먹은 '크나페'라는 거야. 이건 좀...

sentences.en: it's actually a cheesy pudding so it has cheese in it, but it then has a kind of crispy topping that I think is made of honey or sugary syrup, so it has the kind of savoury, which means salty,
sentences.ko: 사실 치즈 푸딩이라서 치즈가 들어 있는데, 그 위에 꿀이나 달달한 시럽으로 만든 것 같은 바삭한 토핑이 있어. 그래서 치즈의 짭짤한(savoury) 맛,

sentences.en: of the cheese – the salty flavour of the cheese – plus the sugary bit at the top.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 치즈의 짠맛에 위쪽의 달콤함이 더해지는 거야.

sentences.en: And it was so delicious.
sentences.ko: 정말 맛있었어.

sentences.en: I ate all of it and it's, yeah, very rich.
sentences.ko: 다 먹었는데, 응, 아주 진해.

sentences.en: That sounds amazing.
sentences.ko: 정말 맛있겠다.

sentences.en: Do you have a favourite one?
sentences.ko: 너는 제일 좋아하는 거 있어?

sentences.en: The one I can remember best – I had it in a restaurant in Argentina about 20 years ago, and I can still remember it.
sentences.ko: 제일 잘 기억나는 건 20년쯤 전에 아르헨티나의 한 레스토랑에서 먹은 건데, 아직도 기억나.

sentences.en: And it was deep-fried ice cream, which sounds crazy.
sentences.ko: 아이스크림 튀김이었는데, 말도 안 되는 것 같지.

sentences.en: It's like ice cream and it was fried in, like, sweet batter or pastry.
sentences.ko: 아이스크림을 달콤한 튀김옷이나 페이스트리 같은 걸로 싸서 튀긴 거야.

sentences.en: It was amazing. And I can remember it 20 years later.
sentences.ko: 정말 끝내줬어. 20년이 지나도 기억나.

sentences.en: That sounds incredible.
sentences.ko: 정말 대단하다.

sentences.en: That's something that's very common in Scotland actually.
sentences.ko: 사실 그건 스코틀랜드에서 아주 흔한 거야.

sentences.en: I'm surprised you had it in Argentina.
sentences.ko: 아르헨티나에서 먹었다니 신기하네.

sentences.en: Maybe not ice cream, but in Scotland they like to deep fry – so, put something in a lot of oil.
sentences.ko: 아이스크림은 아닐 수도 있지만, 스코틀랜드에서는 튀기는 걸 좋아해. 그러니까 기름에 푹 담가서 튀기는 거지.

sentences.en: They do that with chocolate bars and things like that so, yeah, not very healthy.
sentences.ko: 초코바 같은 것도 그렇게 튀겨. 그러니까, 응, 별로 건강하진 않지.

sentences.en: No, not at all...
sentences.ko: 응, 전혀...

sentences.en: but lovely.
sentences.ko: 그래도 맛있지.

sentences.en: So delicious!
sentences.ko: 너무 맛있어!

sentences.en: OK. So, let's recap the vocabulary that we've been looking at today.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 그럼 오늘 살펴본 어휘를 복습해 보자.

sentences.en: We're talking about desserts.
sentences.ko: 디저트에 대해 이야기했지.

sentences.en: We also, particularly in the UK, call them 'puddings'.
sentences.ko: 특히 영국에서는 '푸딩'이라고도 불러.

sentences.en: And that's just something sweet that you eat at the end of a meal.
sentences.ko: 식사 마지막에 먹는 단 음식을 말해.

sentences.en: Yes. If you really like puddings and desserts and sweet things, you could be described as 'having a sweet tooth'.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 푸딩이나 디저트, 단 걸 정말 좋아하면 'having a sweet tooth'라고 표현할 수 있어.

sentences.en: I have a sweet tooth, for example.
sentences.ko: 예를 들어 나는 'I have a sweet tooth'야.

sentences.en: Yes. Of course, puddings aren't just sweet.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 물론 푸딩이 꼭 달기만 한 건 아니야.

sentences.en: I talked about apple crumble, a very traditional British pudding, and it's a little bit 'sharp', which kind of means the same as sour.
sentences.ko: 내가 아주 전통적인 영국 푸딩인 애플 크럼블 얘기를 했는데, 조금 'sharp'하다고 했어. 'sour(신)'와 거의 같은 뜻이야.

sentences.en: So, like, a lemon pudding would be sharp or sour.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 레몬 푸딩은 'sharp' 하거나 'sour' 하겠지.

sentences.en: We also heard the word 'filling', which describes a food or a pudding which makes you feel full.
sentences.ko: 'filling'이라는 단어도 들었는데, 배가 부르게 하는 음식이나 푸딩을 묘사해.

sentences.en: Oh, and Georgie, you said you were a 'chocolate person'.
sentences.ko: 아, 그리고 조지, 너는 자기가 'chocolate person'이라고 했지.

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.ko: 그게 무슨 뜻이야?

sentences.en: That just means that I am a person who really likes chocolate.
sentences.ko: 그냥 초콜릿을 정말 좋아하는 사람이라는 뜻이야.

sentences.en: What kind of person are you, Phil?
sentences.ko: 필, 너는 어떤 타입이야?

sentences.en: I think I might be an ice cream person.
sentences.ko: 나는 아이스크림파인 것 같아.

sentences.en: I'm also an ice cream person.
sentences.ko: 나도 아이스크림파야.

sentences.en: I'm also a chocolate person.
sentences.ko: 초콜릿파이기도 하고.

sentences.en: Well, Phil. That is the end of this episode of Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: 자, 필. 이번 Real Easy English는 여기까지야.

sentences.en: We will of course be back next week with another conversation.
sentences.ko: 물론 다음 주에 또 다른 대화로 돌아올 거야.

sentences.en: Yes, we will.
sentences.ko: 그럼, 돌아올 거야.

sentences.en: And don't forget that we have a worksheet that you can get from our website.
sentences.ko: 그리고 저희 웹사이트에서 워크시트를 받을 수 있다는 것도 잊지 마세요.

sentences.en: And that's bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: bbclearningenglish.com이에요.

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.ko: 안녕히 계세요.

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.ko: 안녕히 계세요.
